academies.blurb: The mathematical spine of engineering and science: sixteen modules from sets, logic, and proofs through linear algebra, calculus, probability, statistics, and numerical methods. Four executable Python labs (NumPy matrix ops, Monte Carlo estimation, gradient descent from scratch, numerical quadrature) make every major idea runnable. Standard, correct mathematics throughout — original instructional content, no invented theorems.

academies.blurb: Philosophy, history, writing, rhetoric, economics, and law as working disciplines for builders: logic and fallacies, three ethical traditions plus applied technology ethics, epistemology and the replication crisis, history of science and technology, technical writing, persuasion, economics for engineers, and policy literacy. Discussion frameworks and ethical decision-tree scenarios throughout.
